status.en: 101 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 30% fewer than the week before, most of them in Abuja, Lagos and Kaduna.
status.nb: 101 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 30 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Abuja, Lagos og Kaduna.

summary.en: Bandits are blocking elections with road blockades and levies in Anka, Zamfara, while soldiers have dislodged bandits and recovered rifles in Kogi. Troops repelled a Berom militia attack on the Ruga Madaki Auwalu community in Plateau and gunmen in military uniforms killed a 60‑year-old security guard and shot two others in Plateau. Armed herders attacked communities and a military base in Benue, and travellers were warned of bandits disguised in military uniforms. Atiku Abubakar condemned a machete attack on former footballer Segun Odegbami, and Galadima accused President Tinubu of neglecting abducted children in Borno. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Banditter blokkerer valg med veiblokader og avgifter i Anka, Zamfara, mens soldater har fordrevet banditter og gjenvunnet rifler i Kogi. Tropper avviste et angrep fra Berom-milits på Ruga Madaki Auwalu-samfunnet i Plateau, og væpnede menn i militæruniformer drepte en 60‑år gammel sikkerhetsvakt og skjøt to andre i Plateau. Væpnede hyrder angrep lokalsamfunn og en militærbase i Benue, og reisende ble advart om banditter forkledd i militæruniformer. Atiku Abubakar fordømte et machetteangrep på den tidligere fotballspilleren Segun Odegbami, og Galadima anklaget president Tinubu for å forsømme bortførte barn i Borno. Konflikten registrerte 1 486 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
